title: Validator draft, pending 05's review
detail: These checks were written by the 02/03 session at the team's request and wait for the validator (05) to review them. Thresholds are the advisor kit's, unchanged.

title: Salt zones sink on NISAR 094D
detail: Median line-of-sight rate over the zone pixels: +23.5 mm/yr from 79 pixels (needs < -2; phase sign -1). Not a global sign error: unwrapping, the ECMWF weather model and NASA's own troposphere screens were all tested and none removes it (notebooks/03/t3_094d_checks.json); the track is shown flagged, for inspection only. Against ground at the same height within 3 km (mm/yr): z1 -4.0, z2 +11.4, z3 +3.2, z4 +8.2.

title: Salt zones sink on NISAR 129A
detail: Median line-of-sight rate over the zone pixels: -11.3 mm/yr from 130 pixels (needs < -2; phase sign -1). Against ground at the same height within 3 km (mm/yr): z1 -18.6, z2 -13.3, z3 -5.7, z4 -5.8.

title: Held-out station HORE against the radars
detail: NISAR 094D: +38.1 vs GNSS -0.9 mm/yr (±78.6, 49 px within 280 m); NISAR 129A: +21.8 vs GNSS -1.1 mm/yr (±55.5, 48 px within 280 m). At least one tolerance is wider than 20 mm/yr (a station-sized box of radar pixels scatters by that much on stable ground), so this neither confirms nor rejects the radar. GNSS observation period 2012 to 2020: it assumes steady motion since. Source: NGL MIDAS (EU-fixed).

title: Held-out station VLC1 against the radars
detail: NISAR 094D: +1.3 vs GNSS -0.6 mm/yr (±78.6, 48 px within 280 m); NISAR 129A: -1.7 vs GNSS -0.6 mm/yr (±55.5, 49 px within 280 m); Sentinel-1 029A: +31.8 vs GNSS -1.1 mm/yr relative to the terrain reference (±40.7, 121 px within 220 m); Sentinel-1 007D: +25.7 vs GNSS -0.2 mm/yr relative to the terrain reference (±37.7, 121 px within 220 m). At least one tolerance is wider than 20 mm/yr (a station-sized box of radar pixels scatters by that much on stable ground), so this neither confirms nor rejects the radar. GNSS observation period 2012 to 2018: it assumes steady motion since. Source: NGL MIDAS (EU-fixed).

detail: NISAR 094D: +1.3 vs GNSS +0.4 mm/yr (±78.5, 48 px within 280 m); NISAR 129A: -1.7 vs GNSS -0.3 mm/yr (±55.5, 49 px within 280 m); Sentinel-1 029A: +31.8 vs GNSS -0.2 mm/yr relative to the terrain reference (±40.7, 121 px within 220 m); Sentinel-1 007D: +25.7 vs GNSS +0.1 mm/yr relative to the terrain reference (±37.7, 121 px within 220 m). title: Tie scatter on NISAR 094D
detail: Robust scatter of NISAR minus euvem on 157186 stable pixels: 47.6 mm/yr per pixel (target < 6); offset correction -15.15 mm/yr; model swap against egms: 0.70 mm/yr (T8 < 1). Per-pixel rates are noise-dominated: read zones and areas, not single dots.

title: Model swap on NISAR 094D
detail: Changing the GNSS model to egms moves the tied rates by 0.70 mm/yr (needs < 1, T8).
